chunks: Praise be to Allah, the Spreader of His bounty among the creation, and the Extender of His hand of generosity among them,
We praise Him in all His affairs, and seek His assistance for the observance of His rights,
and we bear witness that there is no god but He, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger,
He sent him to proclaim His command and speak of His remembrance; so he fulfilled it trustworthily, and passed away on the right path,
ai.seo_question: What is the opening praise and testimony of faith in the supplications of Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This opening formula from Nahj al-Balagha, often recited before the sermons of Imam Ali, establishes a theological framework of divine generosity (Fadl) and human responsibility (Huquq). It emphasizes the Prophet's role as a trustworthy conveyer (Amin) of revelation, a concept deeply resonant in Shia exegesis regarding the preservation of the message. The supplication serves as a bridge between cosmic bounty and the practical duty of fulfilling divine rights through righteous action.
